candidate_relations.reason: Idiopathic CD4 lymphocytopenia is the predisposing immunodeficiency, not the laryngeal histoplasmosis grown from biopsy.
Laryngeal histoplasmosis is identical to the reference: epiglottic plaques, GMS yeasts, and culture of H. capsulatum.
Histoplasmosis of the larynx is a wording variant of laryngeal histoplasmosis confirmed by tuberculate macroconidia in culture.
